systems.owner: Federal Republic of Somalia; Ministry of Communication and Technology chairs the project's steering committee
systems.tiers: to be upgraded and expanded under Part 1.2(a) of a World Bank (IDA) grant of SDR 59.5 million signed 21 June 2023, with a network operations centre, pre-purchased bandwidth for public institutions and fibre deployment; 'public institutions along fiber routes' to be connected, none of them named as a local government; the same for Somaliland under Part 1.2(b)

systems.owner: Federal Republic of Somalia, through sub-projects with operators
systems.tiers: cross-border terrestrial links and national backbone, with a separate allocation for Somaliland; closing date 31 May 2028
consolidated hosting for government, to be financed under Part 2.2(b); the same for Somaliland

note: The financing agreement funds an expanded government network and the connection of 'public institutions along fiber routes' but names no local government office among them, so it describes a backbone and gives no fact about office connection.
